Date: 10-AUG-24 
KIT’s College of Engineering (Autonomous), Kolhapur 
EXAMINATION CELL 
NOTICE 
PAPER SEEING & GRIEVANCES 
It is hereby informed that the online PAPER SEEING & GRIEVANCES facility of F.Y. 
B.Tech. to Final Year B.Tech students for the recently completed ESE-MAY-2024 (Even 
Semester) of the Academic year 2023-24 are now made available From 10-AUG-2024 To 13-
AUG-2024. 
Steps to view answer script and submit grievances: 
1. Login in VM EDU Portal- (Through any Web Browser only) 
https://portal.vmedulife.com/public/auth/#/login/kit-kolhapur 
2. Click on 
3. Select exam form option. 
4. Select student Assessment tab. 
5. Select Academic year 2023-2024. 
6. Click “View” to see answer sheet. 
7. If any Grievances click on “Register Grievances/Recheck” Button on bottom right 
side. 
8. Select request type as “Grievance” from drop down list. 
9. Type detailed description of grievance in “Comment” section. 
10. Click “Save” button to submit grievance. 
NOTE:  
1. Only “Question Not assessed” and “Counting issue” will be considered for grievances 
only. 
2. You can submit grievance per course only one time. 
Dy. Registrar (Post-Exam) 
Examinations & Evaluation 
        Dean, 
            Examinations & Evaluation
